item.title: Karoline Leavitt lashes out at Politico over preview of Trump address on Iran
item.summary: White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt slammed Politico on Wednesday over a report about President Donald Trump's speech on the war in Iran in a post to X.

item.title: Trump supporter allegedly killed by ex-coworker who expressed 'animosity' over political beliefs: complaint
item.summary: Diamond Wallace faces felony homicide charges for allegedly shooting former co-worker Christine Jones in a politically motivated attack in Wisconsin.

item.title: Fatal drug combination sparks alert as 'rhino tranq’ spreads across US
item.summary: The CDC and White House issued a health advisory about medetomidine, a deadly veterinary sedative known as rhino tranq, found in illegal fentanyl.

item.title: GOP rails against 's--- sandwich' deal as all eyes turn to House to end DHS shutdown
item.summary: House Republicans expressed frustration with Speaker Johnson over DHS funding strategy as the record-breaking 48-day partial shutdown continued.

item.title: Trevor Bauer signs with pro baseball team in United States amid MLB return hopes
item.summary: 2020 NL Cy Young Award winner Trevor Bauer announced he is joining the Long Island Ducks, set to start their first game on April 21 in the Atlantic League.

item.title: Artemis II launch steals the show at college softball game as players stare skyward in amazement
item.summary: NASA's Artemis II moon rocket stole the show at a Florida Gators-Stetson softball game as players paused in awe during the historic lunar launch.

item.title: Airline cracks down on crew's weight, fitness and health, warning some staff could be pulled from flights
item.summary: Cabin crew at Air India could face unpaid leave under a new health and fitness policy, with those classified as obese via BMI removed from flight rosters, according to reports.

item.title: WWE NXT star Jacy Jayne ready for Stand & Deliver challenge, says she loves to prove people wrong
item.summary: Jacy Jayne defends the NXT women's championship in a triple-threat match at Stand & Deliver against challengers Kendal Grey and Lola Vice Saturday.

item.title: Ricky Saints hopes to add to his accolades with NXT Championship victory at Stand & Deliver
item.summary: Ricky Saints will compete in a fatal four-way match for the NXT Championship against current champion Joe Hendry, Tony D'Angelo and Ethan Page.

item.title: American Airlines flight diverted to Detroit after passenger allegedly makes ominous threat
item.summary: American Airlines flight made an emergency landing in Detroit after a passenger allegedly made a false bomb threat, according to federal authorities.
